title: A small API app, one decision at a time
description: Build three fixed JavaScript scaffolds using code choices, then trace their behavior. Save between sessions. This is guided practice, not an independently built or executed app.

sessions.title: 1. Reconnect with promises
sessions.intro: A local fixture replaces a network call. Assemble the chain, then trace a fulfilled promise. Nothing is executed here.

slots.label: Return the name from the first callback
slots.scope: Returns a value through this fixed promise chain

slots.label: Display the value in the next callback
slots.scope: Uses the resolved value in a chained callback

slots.label: Handle a rejected operation
slots.scope: Attaches a rejection handler to this fixed chain

slots.label: For the intended chain, what is the console order?
slots.scope: Predicts synchronous and promise callback order in this fixture

sessions.title: 2. Fetch and read a response
sessions.intro: Use a fictional /people endpoint with fixed response cases. Choose each line for loadPerson, then check an HTTP error branch. No endpoint is fetched.

slots.label: Handle an unsuccessful HTTP status
slots.scope: Checks HTTP failure in a fixed fetch scaffold

options.text: // every response is treated as successful

slots.label: Read a JSON response body
slots.scope: Awaits JSON parsing in this fixed scaffold

slots.label: Return the parsed name
slots.scope: Returns a parsed field from this fixed async function

slots.label: With the intended function and HTTP 404, what happens?
slots.scope: Distinguishes HTTP-error handling from successful JSON parsing

sessions.title: 3. Display and review the result
sessions.intro: Assume loadPerson from session 2 returns the name or rejects. output is a text container. Complete the display logic, then trace failure.

slots.label: Tell the learner the request is pending
slots.scope: Provides a pending state in this fixed DOM scaffold

slots.label: Display an untrusted name as text
slots.scope: Chooses textContent for an untrusted field in this fixture

slots.label: Keep failure visible
slots.scope: Provides an error state in this fixed DOM scaffold

slots.label: With the intended display and a rejected load, what remains?
slots.scope: Predicts the rendered failure state in this fixture
